_why: The commands that WRITE a path when a gate spawns them, read by BOTH halves of check:ci-gate-tree-writes (.ci/rediacc_ci/quality/gate_tree_writes.py for Python, scripts/lib/tree-write-sites.ts for TS/JS) so the two scanners cannot disagree about what a mutator is. It lives in .ci/config rather than .ci/policy because it is data, not a BLOCKER-gated decision (.ci/policy/README.md section 1). The pair/list split is pool_writer_safety.py's bash scanner: cp/mv/install/ln write their LAST argument, rm/mkdir/touch/chmod/truncate/tee write every non-flag argument.

git._target: the -C argument, else the cwd option, else the process cwd (the repo root under run.ts)
